title: DX Instrumentation & Onboarding Roadmap: SDKs, Docs, Quickstarts
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Goal: Create a measurable roadmap and tracking cadence for developer experience (DX) efforts that bundles SDK improvements, documentation refresh, and interactive quickstarts. This initiative focuses on instrumenting DX touchpoints (SDK usage telemetry, docs search/IDE flows, quickstart completion), defining OKRs that link to sign-up->first-call conversion and time-to-value metrics, and producing a prioritized backlog for the next three cycles. Deliverables include an instrumentation plan, a docs migration checklist (componentized guides + API reference parity), three guided quickstarts (Node, Python, Docker private deploy), and a lightweight rollout playbook for tracking regressions and rollbacks.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with Eng, Design, and Docs; aligned on primary north star metric: first-successful-inference within 15 minutes of signup.
2026-03-05: Eng proposed telemetry schema for SDK events (install, init, first-request, error-class); dependency ENG-4001 to land schema in backend before client instrumentation begins.
2026-03-08: Design delivered wireframes for a new quickstart flow in Console; DES-306 assigned for microcopy and screen capture assets.
2026-03-10: PM review of proposed OKRs — suggested tightening conversion target and adding a quality retention metric for documentation sessions.
2026-03-12: Blocker: rate-limited API keys for internal e2e tests causing flaky quickstart demos; assigned to ENG-4199 for mitigation.
2026-03-14: Decided to split quickstarts into "intro" and "integrations" tracks; moved one quickstart into follow-up cycle to reduce scope for Q2 launch.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation events available in analytics with documented schema and test harness
Docs search and anchor analytics added; critical API pages have example snippets for Node/Python
Three published quickstarts (one per runtime) with automated smoke tests that run in CI
OKRs and dashboard created: conversion funnel, quickstart completion rate, docs time-on-page, SDK error-rate
Rollout playbook published and linked in Console runbook
okrs: OKR-1: Increase sign-up->first-successful-inference conversion from 22% to 40% by 2026-07-01
OKR-2: Reduce time-to-first-successful-inference median from 35min to <15min for new users
OKR-3: Improve Docs task completion rate (user-reported success) from 68% to 80%
